scope_note: Static STRICT_FALLBACK_001 detection: a Result-returning function whose Ok branch carries an empty/default value (Ok(""), Ok([]), Ok({}), all-zero record, zero-ctor, or a known-empty builder like std/json.jo([])). DECIDED architecture (Mark 2026-07-17 'go with 2'): pass runs AFTER name resolution over elaborated Core, mirroring warn_split_args.go; keyed on resolved $adt.make_Result_Ok identity + a module-qualified knownEmptyBuilders registry (NOT bare name). Threads a let-env through the Core walk to resolve ANF-atomic Var args back to the real value (the C3 risk). Channels: WARNING in dev `ailang check` (exit 0), HARD ERROR under `check --package` (exit 1). @allow_empty_ok("rationale") is the opt-out (rationale REQUIRED). Do NOT re-quorum, do NOT re-open the fork.
baseline_metric: No static enforcement of NO SILENT FALLBACKS; firestore@0.7.1 Ok(jo([])) shipped to production undetected.
premise_corrections: Followed the sprint plan's C1-C9 corrections table (superseding the doc body's surface-AST plan): Core-level pass, not *ast.File-only; keyed on $adt.make_Result_Ok VarGlobal (C2); ANF let-resolver required for Ok([])/Ok(jo([])) since App args are atomic Vars (C3); registry by GlobalRef excludes user-local jo (C4); module pipeline resolves imports to VarGlobal, single-file is a no-op for jo-class (C5); annotations read off surface FuncDecl not Core (C6); lib fixtures import std/result (C7); package channel mirrors checkInterFunctionRefs (C8); changelog at v0.18-current.md (C9).
non_goals: Inter-procedural detection (Err(_) => helperReturningZeros()) — tracked as M-CHECK-STRICT-FALLBACKS-INTERPROC.
invariants: No silent fallbacks: if identity cannot be resolved soundly the pass does NOT guess-flag (user-local jo excluded structurally).
Deterministic sorted output for stable diagnostics.
Depth-bounded resolver (no infinite loop on cyclic let-chains).

milestones.description: Parse @allow_empty_ok("rationale") — name-keyed switch case in parseAnnotation(), REQUIRING a non-empty string-literal rationale.
acceptance_criteria: @allow_empty_ok("x") parses; retrievable via FuncDecl.GetAnnotation("allow_empty_ok") with the rationale.
milestones.notes: parseAllowEmptyOkAnnotation added; PAR_ALLOW_EMPTY_OK_ARG / PAR_ALLOW_EMPTY_OK_EMPTY diagnostics. 3 parser tests (basic, missing-rationale, empty-rationale). All parser tests green.

milestones.description: Pure Core let-chain resolver (resolveAtomic), empty-value classifier (isEmptyValue/isZeroField), and knownEmptyBuilders registry keyed by GlobalRef with joEmpty detector. No wiring.
acceptance_criteria: resolveAtomic walks let t = <val> in ... and returns <val> for Var{t}; depth/cycle bounded.
Registry lookup keyed by GlobalRef{std/json,jo} fires only on the empty form; jo([kv]) does not.
Zero false-positive on non-empty/non-literal values and plain-Var-headed apps (user-local jo).
All-zero record flags; mixed record does not.
milestones.notes: 17 synthetic-Core unit tests cover resolve-through-let, chained/cyclic resolve, jo via registry + via resolved arg, empty/all-zero/mixed records, user-local jo exclusion, and depth bound. Green.

milestones.description: DetectStrictFallbacks(file, prog) + StrictFallbackWarning; wire into single-file and module pipelines as non-blocking warnings.
acceptance_criteria: ailang check fixture.ail prints STRICT_FALLBACK_001 as a warning and exits 0.
Negative fixtures (Ok("real"), user-local jo, annotated, non-Result) print nothing.
